metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation drawstring backpacks for full-color branding. Durable and lightweight. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows you to place vibrant, full-color designs across the entire surface of a drawstring backpack, not just a small imprint area. This makes sublimation drawstring backpacks ideal for event giveaways, school spirit gear, or promotional campaigns where your logo or artwork needs to stand out with photographic detail. The dye-sublimation process bonds the ink into the fabric, producing a soft feel that won't crack or peel over time.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation drawstring backpacks with full-color printed design on front panel
